newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Hero to issue 1996 dividend.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Hero to issue 1996 dividend.

text.p: Shanghai Hero Co on Saturday said it would offer a 1.19-for-10 bonus share issue and a pre-tax cash dividend of 0.079 yuan per share in late August, based on its 1996 net profits.

The Shanghai-listed stationery firm would also offer a 1.59-for-10 bonus share issue based on its capital reserves at the same time, the company said in a statement published in the Shanghai Securities News.
The ex-rights and ex-dividend date would be on August 26 and the bonus shares will be listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange on August 29, the statement said.
The cash dividend for foreign currency B shares would be exchanged into U.S. dollars at a rate of 8.2914 yuan against $1 for a dividend of $0.095279 per share, the statement said.
In a separate statement published in the newspaper, the company announced changes to its outstanding share composition after a 2.6-for-10 rights issue on August 8.

The company now has a total of 207.229 million outstanding shares with 109.654 million state shares, 12.809 million institutional shares, 18.837 million domestic A shares and 65.930 million foreign currency B shares.
The rights shares were sold on August 8 at a price of 3.00 yuan or $0.362 per share, the statement said.
The company's B shares closed at $0.44 per share on Friday.
